== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Scales serve as a form of currency used in various transactions, such as paying for property damage. They are a finite resource because they cannot be produced directly by individuals. Beyond their use as money, scales have practical applications in combat and construction, where they can be applied to weapons or [[constructs]]. They are also frequently distributed to children. For practitioners, scales can be used to facilitate [[advancement]] in power levels, such as reaching the [[Iron stage]]. This process involves condensing [[madra]] into a [[scale]] and then consuming it to stretch the capacity of one's core, though this method is described as being similar to diluting one's own [[madra]].}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|In the [[Desolate Wilds|Wilds]], scales serve as the primary form of currency and treasure. These unique coins are forged from [[madra]] and characterized by their translucent appearance with blue threading. Although they function as money, scales cannot be created directly. While they can be utilized to aid in [[advancement]], using them results in the watering down of an individual's [[madra]].}}
